lines.quote: Designed a 16-element digital beamformer for a wideband receive array, implementing frequency-domain spatial filtering and digital null steering.
Designed and implemented embedded DSP routines in C++ for the company's multi-channel receiver chain, targeting a Zynq UltraScale+ SoC; responsible for the channelisation and demodulation stages

Built and maintained a Python test harness and regression suite (~8k lines) for the receiver signal processing pipeline, used by the entire engineering team and integrated into the Jenkins CI system; handles automated test generation, golden-reference comparison, and nightly performance benchmarking

Ran RF measurement campaigns during prototype bring-up using a Keysight PXA signal analyser and custom probe fixtures; characterised noise figure, gain flatness, and spurious response across the operational band
MSc Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
